initial_inspection_issues: An overbroad terminal summary included the business payload and was truncated. Subsequent reads used selected fields.
Two inspection snippets guessed rows and id keys; actual structures use business and request_id. Raw files were retained.

initial_verifier_failure.exception: TypeError: both arguments should be Rational instances
initial_verifier_failure.cause: Frozen rational oracle numerator/denominator values are decimal strings. The first audit helper passed these strings directly to the two-argument Fraction constructor.
initial_verifier_failure.correction: Parse each numerator and denominator explicitly as an integer before constructing the exact Fraction.

second_verifier_failure.cause: The audit initially treated the directory digest as object-name identity alone. The actual source contract hashes coverage including spatial bounds, so the registered pose correctly changes it.
second_verifier_failure.correction: Require the directory digest to change with the pose alongside scene revision and fingerprint. Keep document epoch and runtime/host sources stable.
